South Africa is the largest beneficiary of duty free access to the American market under the AGOA (African Growth and Opportunity) program.

The country accounts for 54% of all AGOA-related exports to USA and exported $1.7 billion worth of goods to USA under the program in 2025.

Eswatini is building a massive $318 million fuel storage facility to strengthen national energy security.

The Phuzumoya Strategic Fuel Reserve Facility will have the capacity to hold 80 million litres of fuel and diesel. https://t.co/acoI5cOgqm
